gates.name: lint
gates.cmd: set PYTHONPATH=src&& set UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv&& set PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=.cache/pycache-gates-lint&& uv run python -m compileall -q src tests app.py

gates.name: typecheck
gates.cmd: set PYTHONPATH=src&& set UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv&& set PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=.cache/pycache-gates-typecheck&& uv run python -m compileall -q src tests app.py

gates.name: test
gates.cmd: set PYTHONPATH=src&& set UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv&& set PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=.cache/pycache-gates-test&& uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests
